description: On the yellow tabletop there’s a white AirPods charging case in the center and a loose earbud lying to the right. The left hand steadies and opens the case as the right hand reaches in to place an earbud into a slot, then briefly pulls back and returns to adjust it; both hands hover close as the case remains a left-hand object and the earbud alternates between being a right-hand object and resting in the case.
